evidence_refs: fact: WORKPLACES rose from -25.3 to -8.6 over the last three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not higher than its last-28-day mean despite WORKPLACES continuing its upward trend.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -20 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact: TRANSIT moved from -23.3 to -18.3 over the last three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the following two weeks even after TRANSIT sustains above -20 for two consecutive weeks.

evidence_refs: fact: RESIDENTIAL fell from 15.1 to 11.4 while WORKPLACES rose from -25.3 to -8.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean does not exceed its last-28-day mean despite RESIDENTIAL falling and WORKPLACES rising concurrently.

evidence_refs: fact: PARKS recovered from -12.3 to -4.4 over the last two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline over the next four weeks despite PARKS maintaining its seasonal recovery trend.

evidence_refs: fact: PARKS rose 7.9 points from -12.3 to -4.4 in the most recent week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week immediately following a PARKS jump exceeding 5 points, disproving the substitution effect.

evidence_refs: fact: both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT show sustained upward rebounds over the last two weeks

evidence_refs: fact: RETAIL_REC fell from -4.4 to -9.4 between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or continues declining over the two weeks following a drop exceeding 4 points, disproving mean reversion.
